description: This PHP source file defines a database migration class for version 4.4.0 of the OrangeHRM application. It creates multiple tables related to a social posting feature called 'Buzz', adds foreign key constraints, inserts configuration data, and sets up menu and permission configurations.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: A class responsible for executing the database migration for version 4.4.0, specifically creating tables, inserting configuration, and setting up permissions for the 'Buzz' social feature.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Performs the migration by creating tables, defining foreign key constraints, inserting configuration data, and setting up menu items and permissions.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version of this migration, which is '4.4'.

methods.name: insertConfig
methods.description: Helper method to insert configuration key-value pairs into the hs_hr_config table.
